sentences.text: Professor Albus Percival Wulfric Brian Dumbledore is a fictional character in J. K. Rowling 's Harry Potter series .	Harry Potter	Harry Potter	J. K. Rowling	J. K. Rowling
For most of the series , he is the headmaster of the wizarding school Hogwarts .	wizarding	Magic in Harry Potter	Hogwarts	Hogwarts

As part of his backstory , it is revealed that he is the founder and leader of the Order of the Phoenix , an organisation dedicated to fighting Lord Voldemort .	Order of the Phoenix	Order of the Phoenix (fiction)	Lord Voldemort	Lord Voldemort

Dumbledore is portrayed by Richard Harris in the film adaptations of Harry Potter and the Philosopher 's Stone and Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets .	Harry Potter	Harry Potter	Richard Harris	Richard Harris	Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets	Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (film)
After Harris ' death , Michael Gambon portrayed Dumbledore for all of the remaining Harry Potter films .	Harry Potter	Harry Potter	Michael Gambon	Michael Gambon

Jude Law will portray Dumbledore in the untitled sequel to Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them .	Jude Law	Jude Law	Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them	Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (film)

Rowling stated she chose the name Dumbledore , which is an Early Modern English word for `` bumblebee '' , because of Dumbledore 's love of music : she imagined him walking around `` humming to himself a lot '' .	Early Modern English	Early Modern English	bumblebee	bumblebee
